comment.comment: Line comments start with ; and run to end of line. Listed first so a keyword mentioned in prose is never painted.
comment.name: comment.line.semicolon.pol

string.comment: Double-quoted strings — (gap "…"), property text, (load "…"). Second so a keyword inside a string is never painted.
string.name: string.quoted.double.pol

declaration.comment: The kernel's declaration heads (kernel §9): schema/type/instance/initial/transition/equation/form and the file-linking use/load. Head position only, via the fixed-width (?<=\() lookbehind, so a value or entity named like one of these is not miscoloured.
declaration.name: keyword.control.declaration.pol

schema.comment: Schema/arrow/instance clause words and the vacant literal (kernel §9): to/of, the fixed/vacatable arrow flags, the when/do transition bodies, and vacant. Head position only.
schema.name: keyword.other.arrow.pol

guard.comment: Guard connectives and leaf predicates (core/syntax/grammar.ml, guard): and/or/not/is/defined/some. This alternation is what .afk-flow/check-grammar.py asserts against the engine; keep the six as whole ( | ) alternatives. Head position only.
guard.name: support.function.guard.pol

effect.comment: Effect heads (core/syntax/grammar.ml, effect): set/vacate/gap. Also asserted by check-grammar.py as whole ( | ) alternatives. Head position only.
effect.name: keyword.other.effect.pol

modality.comment: The three property modalities in .claims files (core/syntax/claims_parser.ml): never/possible/live. Head position only.
modality.name: keyword.other.modality.pol

interrogator.comment: The interrogator's file-format words (kernel §9) — not the language: property/query/where/accept and the functor/transport vocabulary. Head position only.
interrogator.name: keyword.other.interrogator.pol

rest.comment: The &rest splice marker in a form pattern (kernel §6).
rest.name: keyword.operator.rest.pol

equals.comment: The equation operator = at head position (kernel §9): (= P1 P2).
equals.name: keyword.operator.equation.pol
